title: Velocity at B
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the velocity at point B using work-energy theorem with applied force, gravity, and initial conditions.

title: Time of flight
description: Essential: Correctly solves for the time from B to first impact using kinematic equations with proper sign conventions for displacement and acceleration.

title: Total distance
description: Essential: Correctly determines the total distance traveled until rest using work-energy theorem accounting for air resistance over the entire path.

title: Force resolution
description: Important: Properly resolves the pulling force into components and includes only the horizontal component doing work along the incline.

title: Energy balance setup
description: Important: Correctly sets up work-energy equations with all forces (applied, gravity, air resistance) and proper initial/final conditions.

title: Kinematic equation selection
description: Important: Selects appropriate kinematic equation for projectile motion with constant acceleration (gravity) after force removal.

title: Sign error in kinematics
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for displacement or acceleration in kinematic equations for the falling motion.

title: Air resistance omission
description: Pitfall: Fails to include air resistance in the total distance calculation or uses it incorrectly in work-energy equation.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units throughout calculations and provides final answers with appropriate units.
